summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of Phase 1 Auto Body Shop app. 22/22 backend pytest cases pass covering public (openapi, settings, gallery, reviews), appointment creation validation (missing name/phone -> 422, past date -> 422, invalid/missing time -> 422, >3 photos -> 422, non-image -> 422, happy path -> 201, duplicate within 2 min -> 409), email notification recorded as 'failed:' (expected: EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY not provisioned, booking still succeeds), JWT auth (login success/failure, /auth/me), admin CRUD (list/filter/sort, invalid status, create owner entry with source=owner, update status + date with past-date rejection, delete), and 401 on admin endpoints without/with invalid token. Frontend tested on desktop 1920 and mobile 390: all required data-testid sections present (hero, services incl service-card-collision, gallery with 6 items, reviews 4 cards, booking form, contact footer, placeholder banner). Lightbox opens on gallery click. Booking form inline validation errors (error-name/phone/preferred_date/preferred_time) render on empty submit; date input has min=today (2026-10-19). Happy-path booking submission shows booking-success-message with personalised text. Admin: wrong password shows admin-login-error, correct login reaches dashboard with filters, stats, sort, search, add-appointment button. Add-appointment dialog saves owner entry which shows 'OWNER ENTRY' badge; website submissions show 'WEBSITE' badge. Details sheet opens with status buttons; details-save-schedule-button only renders when date/time is dirty; past-date save -> backend 422; valid date persists. Row-level status change via native select works. Delete flow is accessed from inside details sheet (appointment-delete-button -> delete-confirm-button).

integration_issues.issue: Backend returns 422 'Preferred date cannot be in the past', but no visible toast/inline error is shown to the owner in the details sheet; only a browser console 422 is logged. Users may think save silently failed.

issues: Orange placeholder-banner contrasts strongly with dark theme but is readable; acceptable.

action_items: Add a user-visible error toast when PATCH /api/admin/appointments/{id} returns a validation error (e.g. past date) in AppointmentDetails saveSchedule(). Currently the sheet shows no feedback.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup')/shutdown; migrate to lifespan handler to avoid future removal warnings.
notify_owner fingerprint lock TTL (180s) is slightly larger than DUPLICATE_WINDOW (120s). Fine, but keep in sync via constant.

admin PATCH does not update appointment.preferred_time when only time changes with same string ('' coerced to ''): fine, but when preferred_time submitted equal to existing with empty string it still overwrites updated_at via now_iso only if updates has keys — handled correctly.
AppointmentDetails saveSchedule silently swallows API errors (no toast/error UI). See action_items.
CORS allow_origins defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True; browsers reject credentialed requests with wildcard — set explicit origins in prod.
shop_config.py SAMPLE_GALLERY image URLs point to emergentagent static host; verify long-term availability or self-host.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all required flows verified; only cosmetic missing toast)

seed_data_creation: Backend seed on startup verified: >=6 gallery items, >=4 reviews, owner user, settings doc. Test data (TEST_* prefixed) created and cleaned up via API + UI.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_api.py is complete and runs under 1s with pytest-xdist loadscope. Known environment constraints: EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY missing (email_notification stores 'failed: EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY is not configured'); Emergent Object Storage upstream /init returns 500 so photo uploads will 502 — do not treat as code bug. For UI: service-select & time-select on booking form are NATIVE <select> elements (use page.select_option, not shadcn option clicks). Admin add-appointment time uses native <input type='time'> (use page.fill('09:00')). Delete flow is only available inside the AppointmentDetails sheet, not at the row level. details-save-schedule-button only appears after the date/time becomes dirty.
rca of the issue: Minor UX gap: AppointmentDetails.saveSchedule() does not surface the backend's 422 'Preferred date cannot be in the past' to the user. Reproduction: /admin -> open any appointment details -> change date to a past date -> click 'Save date & time' -> backend returns 422, console shows error, but no toast or inline error renders. Mitigation: wrap the PATCH call in try/catch and call the toast() util with the error.detail (same pattern used in BookingForm.jsx on submit errors).
